request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only two colours. His skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, legs) becomes a deeper, somewhat darker, true goblin green like moss, with a darker green shadow; not yellow, not black. His leather cap, straps and loincloth become a browner, duller orange-brown saddle leather, shaded dark brown, not bright orange and not red. Keep everything else the same: the goggles, the bomb with its stripes and spark, gloves, boots, satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
